purpose: オープニング＆wrapUpのBEFORE。数年前の、にごって生きものの気配がない川
scene: A town river a few years ago as a miniature clay diorama: murky greyish-green water, straight concrete banks on both sides, no plants at the waterline, no fish, a lone shopping cart silhouette NOT included — keep it clean but lifeless; overcast sky, muted colors. A small footbridge crosses mid-frame.
composition: Fixed vantage from the left bank looking downstream, footbridge at mid-frame; the SAME camera will be reused for the AFTER image. Concrete banks dominate both edges.
